text: The LORD said to Moses:
Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that will fall to you as your inheritance — the land of Canaan with its boundaries.
Your southern side shall run from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. Your southern boundary shall begin at the end of the Salt Sea on the east,
then turn south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue on to Zin, and end south of Kadesh Barnea. From there it shall go on to Hazar Addar and pass over to Azmon,
where it shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Sea.
For your western boundary you shall have the Great Sea and its coast. This shall be your western boundary.
This shall be your northern boundary: from the Great Sea mark out a line to Mount Hor,
and from Mount Hor mark out a line to Lebo Hamath, and the boundary shall end at Zedad.
Then the boundary shall go on to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your northern boundary.
For your eastern boundary, mark out a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
The boundary shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue down until it touches the eastern slope of the Sea of Kinnereth.

versions.text: The boundary shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue down until it reaches the slope east of the Sea of Kinnereth.
versions.explanation: 'the slope east of the Sea' may be heard as a slope located away from the sea; the Hebrew describes the eastern shoulder (shoreline) of the sea itself.

text: Then the boundary shall go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land, with its boundaries on every side.
Moses commanded the Israelites: This is the land you are to receive as your inheritance by lot, the land the LORD has commanded to be given to the nine and a half tribes.

For the tribe of the Reubenites by their ancestral houses and the tribe of the Gadites by their ancestral houses have already received their inheritance, and the half-tribe of Manasseh has received theirs as well.

versions.text: For the tribe of Reuben by their families and the tribe of Gad by their families have already received their inheritance, and so has the half-tribe of Manasseh.
versions.explanation: 'לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם' means 'according to their ancestral houses' (fathers' houses), a wider unit than 'families'; also 'and so has' is a compression of the Hebrew verb 'they took/received their inheritance'.

text: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, eastward toward the sunrise.
The LORD said to Moses:
These are the names of the men who shall divide the land among you as your inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
You shall also take one leader, one leader from each tribe, to apportion the land as an inheritance.

versions.text: You shall also take one leader from each tribe to help divide the land.
versions.explanation: 'to help divide' adds a nuance not in the Hebrew, which simply says 'to apportion/inherit the land'; the emphatic repetition 'one leader, one leader' can also be preserved for oral rhythm.

text: And these are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

versions.text: These are their names: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
versions.explanation: The Hebrew repeats 'the names of the men', which makes the antecedent clear when read aloud; 'their names' leaves the referent ambiguous after the preceding verse.

text: from the tribe of Simeon, Shemuel son of Ammihud;
from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Kislon;
the leader from the tribe of Dan, Bukki son of Jogli;
from the sons of Joseph: the leader from the tribe of Manasseh, Hanniel son of Ephod,
and the leader from the tribe of Ephraim, Kemuel son of Shiphtan;
the leader from the tribe of Zebulun, Elizaphan son of Parnach;
the leader from the tribe of Issachar, Paltiel son of Azzan;
the leader from the tribe of Asher, Ahihud son of Shelomi;
the leader from the tribe of Naphtali, Pedahel son of Ammihud.
These are the men the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
